property.title: Single Family Residence In Brentwood
property.description:
Luxury estate in the heart of Brentwood, situated in one of Williamson County's most sought-after areas set on a rare, ultra-private 2-acre lot with no shared lot lines, this exceptional property offers unmatched privacy, fire features with pool, over 1500 square feet of covered patio, and a 6-car garage perfect for collectors and enthusiasts.

This timeless classic home is designed for both refined entertaining and comfortable everyday living. The chef's kitchen features two refrigerators, two dishwashers, and a butler's pantry that flows seamlessly into elegant living spaces. The spectacular dining room boasts floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking serene green pasture, mature trees, and the resort-style pool and patio beyond.

The home offers three private office spaces, a spacious bonus room, a flex room ideal for a home gym and a work room off the garage. All bedrooms are ensuite, including a luxurious downstairs primary suite with two oversized walk-in closets. Two bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level, and two laundry rooms add everyday ease.  There is over 400 square feet of unfinished attic perfect for a mother in-law's suite or just ample storage.  The 2 acres is flat providing plenty of back yard space for a pool house or sports court to be added. 

Outdoor living is equally impressive with a heated pool and hot tub, a fireplace, BBQ, propane heaters, and outdoor TVs — all surrounded by serene, tree-lined grounds. Walk to Granny White Park, minutes from premier shopping, dining, and everything Brentwood has to offer.  Home is elevator ready.  New roof with warranty installed 2026. 

Don't miss this rare opportunity!
